name: [🌟Sendou] Blue Lock: Rivals
desc:
IMPORTANT: This fan-made unofficial game is created by huge Blue Lock fans as a tribute to celebrate the anime and share our passion with the community.

⚽Enter the high-stakes world of Blue Lock: Rivals, inspired by the groundbreaking anime Blue Lock! Compete in electrifying 5v5 soccer matches, where ego and skill shine. 

🔥Choose a character class with unique abilities inspired by the show and dominate the pitch with your skills. Awaken your inner ego, unleashing unstoppable power and precision to claim your place as the ultimate striker.

Team up with friends or face off against fierce rivals—will you rise to the top and prove you're the best in Blue Lock?

This Experience is permitted under Roblox License Manager and has not been subject to official supervision or endorsement by the authors of IP or Kodansha. The content of this Experience has no official connection to the original manga series of “Blue Lock” or any officially licensed content thereof.

scripts.script:
local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet(('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shlexware/Orion/main/source')))()

local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "Projeto LKB", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, ConfigFolder = "Projeto LKB"})

local Tab = Window:MakeTab({
    Name = "Troll",
    Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998",
    PremiumOnly = false
})

local Section = Tab:AddSection({
    Name = "Functions"
})

local P1, P2, P3, P4 = 9999999, 9999999, 9999999, 9999999

_G.RVBall = false

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Remove Ball (Require Ball)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.RVBall = v
        while _G.RVBall do
            local args = {
                [1] = P1,
                [4] = Vector3.new(P2, P3, P4)
            }
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Knit.Services.BallService.RE.Shoot:FireServer(unpack(args))
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end
})

_G.EF1 = false

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Spawn effect (pass)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.EF1 = v
        while _G.EF1 do
            local args = {
                [1] = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Effects.Pass,
                [2] = {
                    ["Char"] = "as"
                }
            }
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Knit.Services.EffectsService.RE.Vfx:FireServer(unpack(args))
            task.wait()
        end
    end
})

_G.TeamShoot = false
local P5, P6 = 200, 200

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "Auto Shoot by Team",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        _G.TeamShoot = v
        while _G.TeamShoot do
            local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local team = player.Team and player.Team.Name
            
            if team == "Home" then
                local args = {
                    [1] = P5,
                    [4] = Vector3.new(319, 11, -4)
                }
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Knit.Services.BallService.RE.Shoot:FireServer(unpack(args))
            elseif team == "Away" then
                local args = {
                    [1] = P6,
                    [4] = Vector3.new(240, 11, -47)
                }
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Knit.Services.BallService.RE.Shoot:FireServer(unpack(args))
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end
})
